inputs.text: DHS said ICE arrested an illegal immigrant gang member after New York City authorities released him, even though he posed a danger to public safety. The department criticized the city, saying the case highlights tensions between sanctuary policies and federal immigration enforcement, along with the potential public safety risks of releasing people with criminal records.
